thread:
Ava Chen: Drafting release notes + internal announce for tomorrow's inference release. Need quick signoff on model pin, canary window, and rollback play. TL;DR: keep default model pinned to v2.3.1 for 48h, roll out v2.4-quant as 10% canary, change window 02:00-05:00 UTC. Draft below — please review & flag anything I missed.

Riley Park: Quick read — looks good. Suggest we explicitly state that dedicated pools remain pinned to v2.3.1 for the full 48h to avoid capacity skew.

Marco Diaz: From product side: confirm this is opt-in for hosted customers (no default change), right? Also add a note about a possible 5-10% latency bump during canary due to new kernel path.

Ava Chen: Correct, Marco — no default model swap. It'll be opt-in via the `model_variant` param. Added latency note to the draft.

Priya Singh: Oncall: I'll be on rotation for the window. Please add me to the incident rota in the RN and include immediate escalation criteria. What is the exact fallback procedure if canary degrades? automatic rollback + region fallback?

Riley Park: Fallback plan: automatic rollback to v2.3.1 for canary traffic if error_rate > 0.5% sustained for 5 minutes OR latency > 20% above baseline. Secondary: route traffic to region fallback (us-east1) if regional infra issue. I'll paste rollback command into RN.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary deploy: model=redwood-embed-quant:v2.4-canary, traffic=10%, region=us-west1, rollout_id=roll-2048201122-1. CI status: all checks passed.

Riley Park: Add explicit rollback command in the RN: `./ops/rollbacks/rollback_model.sh --rollout roll-2048201122-1 --target v2.3.1` and reference ops playbook: https://internal.ops/rollbacks#model.

Liza Romero: I'll tweak the internal announcement copy and publish the console banner. Can you give me the one-liner for the banner? e.g., 'Scheduled canary deploy for redwood-embed; expect minor latency variation 02:00-05:00 UTC'.

Sam O'Neill: Infra note: enforcing the pin for dedicated pools requires a config push to `pool-configs/*` and a restart of the autoscaler. I'll stage the config at 01:50 UTC and coordinate with oncall. Command I'll run: `infractl apply --file pin-v2.3.1.yml --pools pool-dedicated-*`

Ava Chen: Updated draft pasted below (for copy/paste into internal announce). Added rollback command, deploy-bot invocation snippet, oncall rota (Priya), and links to playbooks. Please copy-edit and +1 when ready.

```
INTERNAL RELEASE NOTES (do not forward)
Release: inference-service v2.4 (quantized embed variant) — canary rollout
Window: 02:00-05:00 UTC
What: Opt-in quantized embedding variant (redwood-embed-quant:v2.4-canary) rolled at 10% traffic in us-west1. Default hosted model remains v2.3.1.
Why: 2x memory reduction for embeddings with ~5-10% latency tradeoff in some workloads. Expected token cost savings for high-throughput customers.
Action for engineers: no action required unless you own embeddings/latency-sensitive routes. To test, set `model_variant=redwood-embed-quant:v2.4-canary` in requests.
Rollback criteria: error_rate > 0.5% for 5m OR latency > 20% above baseline -> automatic rollback to v2.3.1 for canary traffic. Manual rollback command: `./ops/rollbacks/rollback_model.sh --rollout roll-2048201122-1 --target v2.3.1` (ops playbook: https://internal.ops/rollbacks#model)
Dedicated pools: pinned to v2.3.1 for 48h starting 02:00 UTC (config change staged by infra).
Oncall: Priya Singh (primary) during window; escalate to Riley Park after 15m of unresolved anomalies.
Metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, embed tail latency, error rate, GPU memory pressure. Dashboard: https://internal.monitoring/dashboards/embed-canary
Contact: @Priya (oncall), @Riley (release lead), @Ava (author)
```

Marco Diaz: LGTM from product. Approving the internal announce copy. @deploy-bot please continue monitoring and hold off on any full rollout until green.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary health check: 20m OK — p95 latency +7% vs baseline, error_rate 0.02% (< threshold). Monitoring continues.

Priya Singh: Acknowledged. I'll escalate if error_rate >0.5% or latency >20%. I'm on pager and reachable via #oncall-priya.

Riley Park: Final: pins enforced until 2024-05-10T00:00:00Z (48h). I'll send the internal announcement at 02:10 UTC after verifying canary health for 30m. Thanks everyone.
